First off, welcome to Voat! A majority if not all of everyone here came from Reddit as some point in time. I am /u/Clayton and I am here to help you on your migration to Voat.

If you see anything in this guide that you would like added, please pm /u/Clayton on Voat.

Common Questions

Q. What is the difference between Submission Points (SP) and Comment Points (CCP)?

A. The difference is that unlike Reddit, submission points are for submissions of all types. While Reddit excludes text post from your overall Submission Points (“submission karma”) Voat includes these in your overall total. Comment point are upvoats you obtain when you comment. Comment points are the true measure of your participation in Voat. If you would like to gain the ability to upvoat unlimited number of post and downvoat, you will need to obtain CCP. We recommend you do this by hanging out in /v/introductions and greeting new people.

Q. What are the current limits on upvoating and downvoating?

A. The current limit (7/12/2015) is 20 CCP to have unlimited upvoats and 100 CCP to be able to downvoat.

Q. Does Voat have Powermods?

A. No. Voat has a strict limit of only allowing one user to mod 10 subs per account.

Q. What is and is not allowed on Voat?

A. Voat is designed and supported for personal use only. You may not use Voat to break the law, violate an individual's privacy, or infringe any person's or entity’s intellectual property or any other proprietary rights. We are not responsible for any decisions you make based on something you read on Voat.

Q. I found a sub that is violating Voat’s rules. How do I report it?

A. Email the violation to abuse@voat.co.

User Etiquette

The user etiquette is somewhat of a how to behave on Voat. It is a guideline on how to keep Voat from turning into the other place.

- Stay on topic. Unlike Reddit, most Voaters enjoy actual discussion. Not the catchphrases and pun threads that plague the other site.

- Downvoats are not disagreement buttons! How many times have you ever said something that challenged the hivemind of Reddit only to be downvoated to oblivion? We hope that won't happen at Voat. The downvoat is supposed to be used for spam and comments that don’t contribute to the conversation. An example of something that does not contribute to the conversation would be pun threads and copypastas.

- Be respectful. Nobody likes a Mr. Grumpy pants. It is okay to disagree, we are humans, not everyone agrees on everything. Just get your points across without devolving into name calling and saying other opinions are not as important. Every opinion is important!

- Posting content from Reddit is okay. Many people have already deleted their Reddit accounts. If you do repost something from Reddit, please do not mark it as OC.

Things to Remember About Voat

- If you forget your password there is nothing Voat can do to help you recover your account, so remember your password.

- As soon as you register your subverse, you should submit at least one post and edit the sidebar. If you abandon your subverse, you may lose it if someone else requests to take it over. If you do not make a first post your subverse will automatically be deleted

- Please be sure to read the User Agreement so you better understand what is allowed and what isn't allowed.

- If you have a bug or site issue please submit it to: https://github.com/voat/voat.

There are couple of config file options you can add to help stop very low fee spam and no-fee spam is being sent over the network. Add the following two settings to your bitcoin.conf file after installing v 0.11.0 and then restart.

minrelaytxfee=0.00005

limitfreerelay=5
SPAM ALERT: If you're running a full node and you want to help slow down the spammers please upgrade to the new Bitcoin Core v0.11.0 released today.

The minrelaytxfee flag has existed in every version since 0.9 and can be hacked into earlier versions rather trivially, either as a flag set in bitcoin.conf or as a new hard limit in main.h which has the same effect.
